reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: Art. V fees are purely usage-based (per US$1m traded, banded, paid monthly in arrears) with no committed volume, minimum spend, take-or-pay or shortfall charge, and no volume cap or floor on Licensee usage.

The p0070 'in no event ... less than' sentence is correctly characterized as a floor measured by actual recorded traded volume (an anti-underreporting mechanic), not a minimum purchase obligation, so it does not trigger MINCOMMIT.

The fixed $2,500/month Technical Support Services fee (p0086) is consideration for services actually provided, which falls within the preferred position ('fees are for usage or ordered services only').

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and no deterministic check flagged an issue; the noted 36-month term/renewal-at-Licensor's-option concern is properly deferred to the TERM/TERMINATION rule rather than redlined here.
